en.headline: Securities industry posts 51.7 billion dollar half-year profit
en.dek: The SFC said net profit rose 21 percent from the previous half, while brokers' trading across stocks, bonds and other securities hit a record 149 trillion dollars.
body: The Securities and Futures Commission said Hong Kong's securities industry made a net profit of 51.7 billion dollars in the first half of the year, up 21 percent from the second half of last year.

The commission's report attributed the result to strong trading and rising client participation. Total income was broadly steady, while expenses and interest costs edged down. Including equities, bonds and other securities traded in Hong Kong and overseas, brokers' turnover reached 149 trillion dollars, a record and 24 percent higher than the previous half. Active clients numbered about 5.7 million at the end of June, 10 percent more than at the end of last year.

Among main income lines, brokerage commission and interest income rose 13 percent to 45.4 billion dollars, while asset-management fees fell 21 percent to 24.4 billion dollars. Combined net profit of Stock Exchange participants rose 20 percent to 23.7 billion dollars, with mid-sized brokers the strongest. Intermediaries executive director Keith Yip said the figures showed resilience in the local securities market, and that the commission would keep working with the industry on risk management, operational resilience and conduct standards.

zh.headline: 證券業上半年淨盈利517億元 經紀交易額創新高
zh.dek: 證監會報告指淨盈利較去年下半年升21%，經紀行股票、債券及其他證券交易總額達149萬億元，活躍客戶約570萬。
body: 證監會報告顯示，香港證券業上半年淨盈利517億元，較去年下半年上升21%，主因交易活動強勁、客戶參與上升。期內總收入大致平穩，開支及利息支出微跌。
連同在香港及海外進行的股票、債券及其他證券交易，上半年經紀行交易總額達149萬億元，創出新高，較去年下半年升24%。截至6月，活躍客戶約570萬人，較去年底增加10%。
主要收入中，交易佣金及利息收入升13%至454億元，資產管理相關費用則跌21%至244億元。聯交所參與者合計淨盈利升20%至237億元，中型經紀行表現最好。中介機構部執行董事葉志衡說，數據反映本港證券市場有韌力，證監會會繼續與業界提升風險管理、營運韌力及操守標準。
